body.summary: Animated science-fiction drama about Uploaded Intelligence (UI): human minds scanned and run as software. Teenager Maddie Kim is contacted online by a stranger who turns out to be her dead father David, secretly scanned by the company Logorhythms. David is hunted by the firm and by a rival UI, Stephen Holstrom's digital successor, while Maddie and a hacker collective try to free him. The first season ends with David apparently destroyed and Maddie discovering the scale of Logorhythms' plan; the second season follows Maddie and Caspian, a young man raised as Holstrom's intended vessel, as the UI war escalates toward a global network of copied minds. ||The series was cancelled before resolving its larger arc.||

arcs.summary: Maddie is messaged by a stranger who proves to be her dead father, uploaded without her family's knowledge; she hides him and helps him survive online.
Logorhythms hunts David as stolen property while Pope pursues him through the network; David learns the limits of his new existence.
Caspian's origins are uncovered: he was raised to host Holstrom's mind, and Maddie's circle tries to free him from that plan.
The UI conflict widens from one fugitive mind to a struggle over who controls copied consciousness at scale.
